items.title: 📢 Advertise With FreeTV Garden
items.text:
Promote your **website, product, app, business, YouTube channel or social media page** to FreeTV Garden visitors.

🇮🇳 India: from **₹29 / 24 hours**
🌍 International: from **$2 USD / 24 hours**
items.more:
**INDIA — 24-HOUR PLANS**

• Standard listing: ₹29 weekdays / ₹39 weekends
• Featured listing: ₹59 weekdays / ₹69 weekends
• Top pinned placement: ₹79 weekdays / ₹99 weekends

**INTERNATIONAL — 24-HOUR PLANS**

• Standard listing: $2 USD
• Featured listing: $2 USD
• Top pinned placement: $2 USD

**PLACEMENT DETAILS**

• Standard: regular position in the Sponsored panel.
• Featured: higher priority than standard listings.
• Top pinned: pinned at the top of the Sponsored panel, subject to availability.

**HOW TO BOOK**

Send your website or social media link, banner or promotional text, target audience and preferred start date. We will confirm availability, placement and payment details before publishing.

All plans run for 24 hours from the agreed start time. Weekend pricing is an introductory proposal, not a verified traffic-based rate. Ads are shown to visitors who open the Sponsored panel; impressions, clicks and sales are not guaranteed. All ads are subject to review and approval.

footer: Sponsored content: FreeTV Garden may be paid for these placements. Links open the advertiser's own site, which we do not control.
